mapper.select: SELECT no, contentid, hit, title, image1, address FROM busantravel WHERE contenttype = #{contenttype} ORDER BY no ASC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT no, contentid, hit, title, image1, address, contenttype FROM busantravel WHERE address LIKE '%'||#{address}||'%' ORDER BY no ASC OFFSET #{start} ROWS FETCH NEXT 12 ROWS ONLY
SELECT CEIL(COUNT(*)/12.0) FROM busantravel WHERE address LIKE '%'||#{address}||'%'

SELECT no, contentid, hit, title, image1, address, usetime, restdate, parking, ROWNUM FROM (SELECT b.no, b.contentid, hit, title, image1, address, usetime, restdate, parking FROM busantravel b, attraction a WHERE b.contentid = a.contentid ORDER BY hit DESC) WHERE ROWNUM<=4
